verdict.rationale: Insomnia's docs mention concrete AI features—prompt-based mock server generation and AI-suggested Git commit messages—showing some AI-generated output tied to user actions, but these are narrow generation helpers rather than broader AI-driven insights/suggestions analyzing the user's API data (e.g., test results, request patterns, error trends). Missing for 10: AI analysis of existing collections/test results/traffic for insights, broader in-app AI suggestions beyond mock generation and commit messages, and independent corroboration of these AI features working well in practice.
